settings.title: What is this for?
settings.content:
• Estheticians & Skincare Professionals: For providing hands-on, comfortable microcurrent treatments to clients.
  • Advanced At-Home Users: Individuals familiar with microcurrent therapy looking for a more personalized, hands-on approach.
  • People with Sensitive or Acne-Prone Skin: Thanks to the antimicrobial properties.
  • Those Seeking Sculpted, Lifted Facial Results: Ideal for targeting sagging skin, loss of tone, or puffiness.

settings.title: How to use it?
settings.content:
Preparation:

  • Put on vinyl, latex, or nitrile gloves first (inner layer) to insulate and properly direct current.
  • Then wear the conductive gloves over them.
  • Soak your palms and fingers in distilled water.
  • Remove excess water by making a tight fist. 

Connection:

  • Attach the lead wires to each glove and connect them to your MyoLift™ device.

Operation:

  • Adjust the microcurrent intensity on your device.
  • Use both hands to glide across the face or body with consistent pressure and direction, following recommended treatment patterns.

Pro Tip: Spray the Infused Conductive Solution onto the skin.

Cleaning & Care:

  • Gently hand wash with antibacterial soap.
  •  Air dry thoroughly before storing -- Do not wring or twist
  • Optional: Lightly spray with alcohol but rinse afterward to avoid corrosion.

settings.title: Features
settings.content:
• Silver-Threaded Nylon: Provides excellent conductivity while maintaining flexibility and comfort.
  • Universal Compatibility: Works with all MyoLift™ devices (Mini, QT, Triwave).
  • Adjustable Microcurrent Intensity: Controlled through pressure applied during the treatment.
  • Antimicrobial Material: Reduces bacterial growth and improves hygiene.
  • Reusable and Washable: Easy to clean and maintain with proper care.
  • No Gel Needed: When used correctly with inner protective gloves, conductive gels may not be required.

settings.title: Elevate Your Microcurrent Therapy
settings.text: It can be used with all MyoLift™ Devices

settings.heading: Why You’ll Love It
settings.benefits_content1: Offers more natural and flexible movement during microcurrent treatments.
settings.benefits_content2: Enhances absorption of serums or conductive gels into the skin.
settings.benefits_content3: Allows targeted pressure to lift, tone, and contour facial muscles.
settings.benefits_content4: Gloves provide a gentle and even application without metal probes.
settings.benefits_content5: Silver-threaded material helps reduce bacteria on the gloves, ideal for acne-prone or sensitive skin.

settings.title: Required Minimum Maintenance
settings.text:
This pair of gloves will go a long way into a non-invasive skincare journey and will help to re-educate facial muscles.

There are three simple ways to take care of conductive gloves

  • To clean, use antibacterial soap.
  • Do not twist the gloves after washing to wring out excess water.
  • The conductive microcurrent gloves should air dry.

settings.title: The Esthetician’s Secret to Effortless Microcurrent Massage
settings.text:
Experience a seamless, hands-on approach to microcurrent therapy with Conductive Gloves—a game-changer for professionals. Compatible with all MyoLift devices, this hands-free solution allows for intuitive control, precise pressure, and enhanced sculpting, ensuring optimal results with every session.

Trusted by estheticians, these gloves offer greater flexibility and precision, making microcurrent massage sessions more effective and effortless.

settings.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
settings.title1: Are these gloves compatible with all microcurrent devices?
settings.text1: Yes! They are designed to work with most microcurrent machines.
settings.title2: Do I need to use conductive gel with the gloves?
settings.text2: Yes, applying a thin layer of conductive gel enhances conductivity and ensures a smooth treatment.
settings.title3: How do I clean the gloves?
settings.text3: Wash with mild soap and water, air dry completely, and store in a cool, dry place.
settings.title4: Can I use these gloves on my body?
settings.text4: Absolutely! They are perfect for both facial and body treatments.
